source_title: 2026届毕业设计 | 元素情报局
core_aesthetic_takeaways: The project proves that academic information visualization can be playful, high-saturation and character-driven when the topic is educational science.
The strongest move is a two-mode system: clean white manual pages for IP rules and black neon boards for dense intelligence-style information.
Mascots, reaction stickers, chemical icons, periodic-table tiles and product extensions form one visual ecology rather than isolated illustrations.
High innovation comes from a controlled collision: cute mascot language plus dark technical-data interface plus physical product proof.
prompt_structure_lessons: First define the science metaphor and IP universe; do not start with color.
Specify two background modes: white system manual mode and black neon data-board mode.
Describe mascot family rules, expression pack categories, diagram modules, product applications and exhibition proof as separate prompt sections.
Require exact visible titles and source-verified scientific labels; put uncertain formulas into placeholders.
Use high saturation only with category roles and modular boundaries.

rules: Scientific names, element symbols, formulas, charts and legends require source text.
Small microcopy should be rendered as neutral editable blocks unless exact copy is supplied.
No pseudo-Chinese, mojibake, fake equations or invented experiment labels.

risk_controls: One system anchor before many characters.
Separate illustration, data, product and exhibition modules.
Use black-neon contrast for information focus, not decorative glow.
Keep the project in academic/educational logic, not commercial toy advertising.
recommended_training_use: High-weight memory for bold academic science infovis.
Reference for IP-driven information visualization and graduation project boards.
Reference for converting a research topic into mascot, sticker, book, merchandise and exhibition systems.
Failure-prevention memory for neon pop designs that must still keep layout order and text accuracy.
